messages:
Jamal: starting rolling deploy for routing v2 now. watching SLOs for 20m, tagging @Oncall
metrics-bot: ALERT: p95 latency /v2/generate crossed 600ms on canary (now 650ms). error rate 5% (baseline 0.3%). bump in kv-cache misses. chart: https://grafana.redwood/s/XYZ
Priya: notable. svcs:embed-service KVMissRate spiked 18:45-18:47. can someone grab logs for one of the slow requests?
Sasha: pulled a sample, looks like kvcache miss + db fallback causing 500ms added. log snippet:
```
[18:46:12] request_id=abc123 route=canary kvcache_miss=true ttl=0 db_query_ms=420 downstream_err=0
[18:46:13] request_id=abc124 route=canary kvcache_miss=true db_query_ms=480 downstream_err=1
```
Eva: ok, can we confirm this is a model-variant change that invalidated caches? any config pushed recently?
Jamal: I pushed model build v2.2 which changes tokenizer vocab size (KV key schema changed). I missed a cache-warm job. my bad.
Priya: recommend pausing ramp to prevent more cold-cache hits. Also pin canary back to v1.14.2 until warm job runs.
Jamal: executing pause and pin now:
```
# pause ramp
deploy-bot pause --route canary --by jamal
# pin to stable
deploy-bot pin --route canary --version v1.14.2 --reason "kvcache schema regression"
```
deploy-bot: Done. canary ramp paused. route canary pinned to v1.14.2 by jamal.
Oncall: rolling back live canary traffic to 0% to stop user impact.
Jamal: running rollout revert:
```
deploy-bot route shift --from canary --to stable --percent 0 --strategy immediate
```
deploy-bot: traffic shift complete. canary at 0%.
Sasha: monitoring p95, looks like it dropped back to 220ms in the last 2m. errors down to 0.7%.
metrics-bot: RESOLVED: p95 back under threshold. incident window ~5m.
Eva: file follow-up: add cache-warm job to deploy playbook and add preflight kvcache check to deploywatch.
Jamal: adding a release note and a postmortem draft. Will schedule a quick retro.
Priya: thanks all. :thumbsup:
Sasha: :rocket:
Jamal: closing thread, will update #release-notes when postmortem done.
